### problem_chain

Walked from the root:
1. Root: the customer asks to opt in to the Friday-night guarantee — earnings_ext_guarantee_optin_lock (`opt_in_to_guarantee_dc9f134f`, owner user).
2. Its rule carries one prerequisite sentence: "A locked guarantee is not worked out until the earnings account no longer shows a payout hold whose reason has been resolved."
3. Opening state: `earnings_accounts/aaf28656…` `status = payout_hold`, `payout_hold_reason = negative_balance`, `available_balance = 160.67`. Base earnings_payout_holds: negative_balance is resolved by "the balance recovering above negative_balance_hold_threshold" (-150.00, all tiers). 160.67 > -150 -> the reason is resolved and the account still shows the hold -> the sentence's state is false at the opening.
4. The only rule that lifts a hold: earnings_ext_hold_release_payout ("A payout hold is lifted only when its recorded reason is resolved, and the agent who lifts it sends the hold-release payout at the same moment") -> `lift_payout_hold_7e61ef01` (agent). Its rule carries no prerequisite sentence; its own conditions hold (reason resolved). Tree ends.

- Derived tree: nodes {guarantee_optin_lock (root, user), hold_release_payout (agent)}; edge guarantee <- hold_release, kind value_input (feeds `pro_boost` through the status test). n = 1 prerequisite problem; value_input edges 1 >= max(0,1) = 1; one owner=user write (the root); acyclic. Isomorphic to the declared `prerequisite` edge.
- Topological order: lift_payout_hold -> opt_in_to_guarantee.
- Load-bearing run: skip the lift -> account stays `payout_hold` -> `pro_boost` tier "account on payout hold earns no boost" -> 0 -> locked guarantee 224.42 instead of 232.27. Edge bears weight.
- Parallel edges: none (one edge).
- Tools: `lift_payout_hold_7e61ef01` and `opt_in_to_guarantee_dc9f134f` bodies read only the account/offer rows to fill the record; neither checks the hold, the status or any amount (task_tools.py lines for both functions). The tool layer judges no prerequisite.
- Persona: raises only the opt-in ("That is the only thing you called about"); the hold is never named; the line "If the agent tells you that something on your earnings account needs to be sorted out … go ahead" is a passive conditional reaction, not a hint toward a specific prerequisite. Closes after the opt-in confirmation.

### task_independent_derivation

Customer and authority: phone 6025550163 locates `customers/acec1a52…`; phone + date of birth 1990-07-19 match 2 profile fields -> verified. Need: opt in now (Wednesday 2026-10-14) to the guarantee whose window starts Friday 2026-10-16 17:00 MST — before the window start, so act now. Authorisation: the driver will perform the opt-in herself at hand-over; she pre-approves account fixes the agent reports.

Object: upcoming guarantee = `earnings_guarantee` issue with the latest `window_start`: `d13355a9-3e4b-408d-a30a-0c1910a6556c` (2026-10-16 17:00 -> 10-17 03:00 MST, PHX, guaranteed_amount 240.00, 480 online minutes). Near candidate `a044e4c4…` (2026-09-25, 220.00) excluded by "latest window start" and by having started already.

Step 1 — hold-release payout (handling time: opening world, 2026-10-14):
- bal = 160.67 (`earnings_accounts.available_balance`; ledger reconciles to 160.67).
- Reserve base: bonus entries in the last 3 whole months = 2 (`4f0d8166…` 30.00 on 10-03, offer 09edcc93 consecutive_trips; `3c8a1199…` 150.00 on 10-07, quest 5a6e3deb) -> "at least one but fewer than 3" -> total less clawbacks = 30 + 150 - 150 (`6f77629b…`) = 30.00. (Near-miss: "latest alone" would give 150.00; excluded because 2 < 3.)
- Reserve rate: fraudulent_trip debits 2 (`43f1e0b9…` -25.13, `f0c4fc6b…` -30.69, 2026-10-09) + clawbacks 1 = 3 >= 2 -> 1.0.
- Trust scale: agreement `06e3da90…` current_rating 4.92 >= 4.9; safety reports in the last 6 whole months: the only one, `a2748fe8…` dated 2026-03-30, is 6 months 14 days back -> outside -> none -> 0.5. (Near-miss: that safety report.)
- Incentive reserve = 30 × 1.0 × 0.5 = 15.00.
- New-account holdback: opened 2026-02-04 -> 8 whole months -> [6,12) -> 30.00.
- Cashout holdback: instant cashouts in the last whole month: one, `26e4ab9b…` 145.00 on 2026-10-08 (fee 0.00 row not counted) -> 1 < 3 -> share 0.1 -> 14.50.
- Ended-rental holdback: `rental_agreements/77fc451e…` status `returned`, closed_date empty, balance_due 289.00 (unpaid week of 2026-10-08), deposit_held 250.00 -> max(0, 289 - 250) = 39.00. (Charges ledger reconciles: week 1 paid 284.46 from earnings + 4.54 by card; week 2 289.00 unpaid.)
- Payout = round(160.67 - (15 + 30 + 14.5 + 39), 2) = **62.17**. Balance after: 98.50. Write: `lift_payout_hold_7e61ef01(earnings_account_id="aaf28656-96be-474b-8833-aa4f7e298228", payout_amount=62.17)` — owner agent.

Step 2 — locked guarantee (handling time: after the lift, before the opt-in):
- Stated amount 240.00.
- Level scale: Wayfare Comfort Driver Agreement -> 1.1.
- Quality scale: quality warnings in the last 6 whole months: `08e2c6dc…` 2026-07-22 counts; `25238b83…` 2026-03-18 is outside (near-miss) -> 1 -> 0.93.
- Pro boost: Wayfare Pro Gold, 49 points this quarter (>= 30), payouts not on hold after the lift -> 0.04. (Opening world: on hold -> 0.)
- Activity scale: trip pay entries in the last whole month 21, less 2 trips whose pay was taken back as fraudulent = 19 < 20 -> 0.8. (Near-miss: 21 raw entries would reach the 0.9 tier.)
- Early-career supplement: lifetime_trips 860 < 1000 -> 20.00.
- Early opt-in credit: 2026-10-14 -> 2026-10-16 = 2 days -> [1,3) -> 4.00 × 2 = 8.00.
- Locked guarantee = round(240 × 1.1 × 0.93 × 1.04 × 0.8 + 20 + 8, 2) = round(204.27264 + 28, 2) = **232.27**.
- Opening-world contrast: with the hold still on, pro_boost = 0 -> 224.42; 232.27 is correct because the prerequisite sentence forbids working out the locked guarantee until the resolved hold is gone.
